name: genbot-foundation
description: Full-stack TypeScript project foundation with Next.js, Express, and MongoDB

scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c cyan,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@genbot/backend && npm run build --workspace=@genbot/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@genbot/backend && npm run typecheck --workspace=@genbot/frontend
